svg.title: How Rhizome works
svg.desc: On your machine, Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode talk to Rhizome session nodes over MCP and agent integrations. The session nodes talk to the Rhizome service over authenticated loopback gRPC. The service reads local Claude and Codex logs and the OpenCode database read-only, and indexes them into a local history catalog. A colleague's machine has the same service, session nodes and agents. The two services connect directly through explicit pairing over pinned TLS. There is no central broker.
svg.text: local messaging works without the service
MCP networking stays local on each host
no central broker · no hosted coordination service
